user.title: ERM Zapad power outages
user.description: What to monitor. A client number is exact and also reports unplanned outages; a place uses the daily planned schedules and is only indicative.

client.title: Client number
client.description: The 12-digit client number from the electricity bill. Add each client number separately.

data_description.client_number: 12 digits, e.g. 300000000000. Metering points (32Z…) are not supported.

place.title: Place to monitor
place.description: Name of the place as written in the ERM Zapad daily schedules (Cyrillic, case does not matter). It is matched as a substring of the place names in the schedule, e.g. ЗЛАТУША, ОБЕЛЯ, ГОРНА БАНЯ.

data_description.place: Village, town or quarter, e.g. ЗЛАТУША.
data_description.district: Narrows the match when the name exists in several municipalities, e.g. БОЖУРИЩЕ. For Sofia this is the district (ВРЪБНИЦА, ОВЧА КУПЕЛ).

reconfigure.title: Change the monitored target
reconfigure.description: Enter a new client number or place (same kind as before).

data_description.place: Village, town or quarter, e.g. ЗЛАТУША.
data_description.district: Narrows the match when the name exists in several municipalities, e.g. БОЖУРИЩЕ.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the ERM Zapad website.
error.rate_limited: ERM Zapad refused the request (request limit reached). Try again later.
error.invalid_client_number: The client number must have exactly 12 digits.
error.unknown_client_number: ERM Zapad does not know this client number. Check it on the electricity bill.

abort.already_configured: This client number or place is already configured.
